This small plot of 0.10 hectares is where I grow this other crop, mostly for our own use and some local sale. I do not buy chemical fertilizer for it because I need to save the fertilizer I can get for my larger cereal fields, but I do put compost and manure from our animals on it to help it grow. My children and I work on it ourselves when we have time from the other fields, so we do not hire workers from outside. I plant with the seeds and cuttings I have saved from before, and I do not use any sprays or irrigation since the rain is enough for this small plot.
